title: WHIL Wednesday – Picture of the Week
content:
East India Youth. Image: Will Fahy

15 April 2015

After a few weeks off, Picture of the Week returns – this week it’s William Doyle of East India Youth.

Take a look at the concentration on his face as he masters a table full of electronics at The Louisiana in Bristol. The Mercury award nominee has just released his second album Culture of Volume and will be touring hard across America throughout May – he’ll be back in Bristol at The Exchange in June.

Will Fahy

If you have any images you’d like to submit for Picture of the Week, send them to contact@thefixmagazine.com
